$schema: Single source of truth for gym registry. Both gyms.ts (bot) and migrate-blob-layout.mjs (one-shot script) read this so adding a gym is a one-line change. passwordEnv is optional metadata used by the scraper, not the bot. A 'retired' date marks a gym the owner no longer operates: it stays here so historic blob data under csv/<slug>/ remains resolvable by name, but it is excluded from the active roster (digest, chat tools, scraper).
